value.title: CROWN Verification GPU Optimization Results and Hybrid Approach

facts.statement: GPU optimized mode (cuBLAS + Pool) completed CROWN verification with elapsed time 229.691800 ms.
facts.limits: Single run measurement; comparison baseline CPU time not specified in this page.

facts.statement: GPU optimized mode reduced elapsed time by about 100 ms compared to the prior measurement, but was still slower than CPU.
facts.limits: Exact prior time and CPU time are not stated on this page; reduction is described as 'about 100ms'.

facts.statement: Applied optimizations in GPU optimized mode were: replace matmul with cuBLAS, use a memory pool to avoid per-call allocation/deallocation, and move vector operations to CPU.
facts.limits: Implementation details beyond these three items are not provided on this page.

facts.statement: A hybrid program was created that executes only matmul on GPU.
facts.limits: Hybrid mode performance characteristics are described on the next page; this page only states the creation decision.
